{# Schema-version dropdown. Both schema versions are documented inside this single Sphinx build — v2 at the root, v1 under v1/ — so the links are resolved at build time with pathto() rather than fetched from a switcher.json. That means the dropdown works offline, works when the docs are served from a subpath, and can never point at a page that does not exist. Versions are declared in conf.py as html_context["schema_versions"]: [{"name": ..., "root": , "note": ..., "prefix": }, ...] #} {%- set versions = schema_versions | default([], true) -%} {%- if versions -%} {#- Work out which version the current page belongs to: the active entry is the one whose "prefix" directory contains this page. The entry with an empty prefix is the default version (documented at the root) and acts as the fallback for any page not under one of the prefixed directories. -#} {%- set ns = namespace(active=versions[0]) -%} {%- for v in versions -%} {%- if not v.prefix -%} {%- set ns.active = v -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- for v in versions -%} {%- if v.prefix and (pagename == v.prefix or pagename.startswith(v.prefix ~ "/")) -%} {%- set ns.active = v -%} {%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%}
  • {{ _('Schema version') }}
    • {%- for v in versions %}
  • {{ v.name }} {%- if v.note %} {{ v.note }} {%- endif %}
    • {%- endfor %}
{%- endif -%}
